ground_truth.scope_limit: Confirms the machine condition only; it does not prove the cause or authorize a remedy.

A blocker is recorded and the same frozen record carries no output reference and no remedy evidence, so nothing contradicts the blocker. Internal consistency only — not proof the blocker's cause is correct.
